reference.author: Nixtio
reference.interpretation: Public reference is a single rendered dashboard, not an underlying token/component specification. Marketplace tokens and responsive behavior are original adaptations, not extracted hidden source.

principles: One interactive action blue; pastel colors are surfaces, not competing action colors
No invented commercial guarantees, statistics, discounts or testimonials
No avatars, characters or mascots in campaign banners
Hairlines and surface shifts instead of chrome shadows
Keyboard focus, visible labels, reduced motion and native modal focus management

responsive.mobile: Bottom navigation with five items, native modal navigation, collapsible filters, one-column forms, wrapping cards and horizontal comparison tables
responsive.tablet: Compact rail, two-column discovery tiles, adaptive authentication panel and wrapped admin navigation
responsive.desktop: Persistent dark rail, split hero and authentication composition, multi-column cards and admin navigation

figma.method: Manually authored SVG primitives pasted through the user's browser; native editable vectors/text/frames; no Figma AI
figma.prototypePurpose: Clickable screen-review sequence; application behavior, permissions and data states are implemented in source

authentication.registration: Email uniqueness is case-insensitive; phone optional for email-only buyers; password validators applied; new accounts are not staff
authentication.staff: Retain existing phone challenge and password; email password cannot bypass staff OTP
authentication.emailVerification: Email registration is not proof of email ownership; email verification/recovery provider is not configured by this change

banners.support: Guides and support conversations; warm sand surface
